outcome: DNA methylation changes in fetal and placental tissues
Enrichment for candidate autism spectrum disorder (ASD) genes
cohort: Pregnant rhesus macaques consumed a daily edible containing either delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) or placebo.
finding: Prenatal THC exposure alters placental and fetal DNA methylation at genes involved in neurobehavioral development, with loci enriched for candidate autism spectrum disorder genes.
